commented.title: fix: fix panic recovery vulnerability in event emission
commented.author: xiaoyulox
commented.technical_background: The event package emits runner events into channels that downstream graph and runner code consume asynchronously. These events are mutable structs, so send-time ownership and error propagation are part of the concurrency contract.
commented.problem: The change tries to recover from sends to closed event channels, but it also changes when events are snapshotted for logging and how graph emitter errors are propagated.
commented.problem_framing: Closed-channel recovery is useful only if it does not reintroduce races, hide cancellation, or make production recovery logs less informative.
commented.root_cause: The slow path snapshots after channel send, the graph wrapper discards all send errors, and the fast-path recovery uses a trace-only snapshot string.
commented.approach: The patch adds local recover blocks around event sends and converts the graph emitter to best-effort delivery.
commented.implementation_derivation: The modified paths are exactly the channel-send wrappers used by normal graph event delivery, so small changes here affect all graph node event semantics.
commented.solution_fit_assessment: The panic boundary is the right layer, but the implementation needs narrower error suppression and pre-send snapshots to preserve existing contracts.
commented.alternative_designs: A typed closed-channel sentinel or an event-layer best-effort mode could isolate closed-channel recovery without swallowing timeout and context failures.
commented.tradeoffs: Recovering from closed-channel panics improves resilience, but broad suppression weakens backpressure and makes missed events harder to diagnose.
commented.design_assessment: The design is close but currently mixes a resilience fix with behavior changes that callers can observe.
commented.api_surface: No new exported API, but observable EventEmitter error behavior changes.
commented.change_inventory: Event send helpers, graph emitter wrapper, and event logging behavior were changed.
commented.semantic_changes: Closed-channel panic is converted to an error or nil, but timeout/cancel delivery failures may now be hidden from graph callers.
commented.module_impact: Graph node execution can lose event-delivery failures that previously reached callers.
commented.cross_module_impact: Runner observability and trace logging depend on the same event snapshots.
commented.behavior_impact: Trace logging can race with receiver mutation on the slow path, and production warning logs can be missing event details.
commented.tests_docs: Needs regression tests for canceled contexts, timeout propagation, and closed-channel recovery logs.

`snapshotEvent(e)` runs after `ch <- e`, so a receiver can mutate the event before the trace log reads it and reintroduce the data race this code previously avoided. Snapshot once before the slow-path `select` and reuse that value for both no-timeout and timeout success logs.
<details><summary>中文</summary>
`snapshotEvent(e)` 现在发生在 `ch <- e` 成功之后，接收方可能已经开始修改这个 event，trace 日志再读取它就会重新引入这段代码之前专门避免的数据竞争。建议在慢路径 `select` 之前先做一次 snapshot，并在无 timeout 和有 timeout 的成功日志里复用这个值。
</details>

`emitWithRecover` now drops every `EmitEventWithTimeout` error, not just recovered closed-channel panics, so timeout and canceled-context failures look successful to graph nodes. Preserve timeout/context errors and only suppress the specific closed-channel recovery case, with a regression for canceled contexts.
<details><summary>中文</summary>
`emitWithRecover` 现在会吞掉所有 `EmitEventWithTimeout` 错误，而不只是关闭 channel 的 panic 恢复，所以 timeout 或 context canceled 的发送失败会被 graph 节点当成成功。建议继续返回 timeout/context 错误，只对关闭 channel 的恢复场景做 best-effort 吞掉，并补一个 canceled context 的回归测试。
</details>

`eventStr` is still used for fast-path panic logging, so production logs with trace disabled can lose the event details this fix is meant to preserve. Use `redactedEventForLogging(e)` in the recovery log and keep `eventStr` only for successful trace output.
<details><summary>中文</summary>
fast path 的 panic 日志仍然使用 `eventStr`，而 trace 关闭时它会是空字符串，生产日志会丢掉这次修复本来想保留的 event 细节。建议 recovery 日志改用 `redactedEventForLogging(e)`，`eventStr` 只用于成功发送时的 trace 输出。
</details>
